convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator 'ROC2_VG' which is not a built-in MT5 indicator, and depends on external .mqh library 'TradeAlgorithms.mqh' for position management, money management, and trade execution functions

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds for signal expiry
derived_values.used_by: BuyPositionOpen and SellPositionOpen signal time parameter

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation

other_exits: BuyPosClose and SellPosClose flags controlled by input booleans BuyPosClose/SellPosClose - when opposite signal occurs, existing position is closed if enabled

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum controls sizing: LOT=fixed lot size (0.1), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. MM=0.1 serves as either lot size (LOT mode) or percentage fraction (other modes)

custom_logic_notes: Invert input swaps Up/Down indicator buffers (Buffer0<->Buffer1), effectively reversing the trading direction. Entry uses 2-bar lookback: crossover detected when UpIndSeries[1]>DnIndSeries[1] AND UpIndSeries[0]<=DnIndSeries[0] (previous bar crossed above, bar before that was at or below). Signal is recalculated on recount flag or new bar. BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/SellPositionClose/BuyPositionClose and GlobalVariableDel_ are from TradeAlgorithms.mqh - exact position gating behavior depends on that library. CIsNewBar class from TradeAlgorithms.mqh handles new bar detection. LoadHistory ensures sufficient bar data before signal calculation.
python_conversion_notes: The ROC2_VG custom indicator must be replicated in Python - it produces two buffers (Up/Down lines) based on configurable ROC types (MOM, ROC, ROCP, ROCR, ROCR100) with two periods. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, CIsNewBar, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory) need reimplementation. Position sizing logic is conditional on MarginMode enum - LOT mode uses fixed lots, others compute fraction of margin/balance. The crossover detection uses a 2-bar lookback pattern comparing [1] vs [0] values, not a simple single-bar comparison. Signal bar index is configurable (default=1, meaning previous completed bar). Invert flag swaps which buffer is treated as Up vs Down.
